title: Typography
slide_intent: Introduce the type system while marking its status. Readers need to know how far they can rely on the details in a working edition.
strategic_value: Instacart can communicate the intended typographic voice while calling attention to an unresolved part of the February 2022 book.
demonstration: The large pale section title stands on a dark green field. A small red circle states that the section will be finished when the typeface is complete.
practical_value: Use the following pages to study direction and examples, and verify unsettled specifications before putting them into production.

content_islands.name: Section title
content_islands.spec: Place Typography in large light letters across the upper-left portion of the green page.

content_islands.name: Work-in-progress note
content_islands.spec: Place the compact red circular status note at lower right. Keep its wording distinct from the section title.
